newsitem.title: USA: Mentor backs Q2, FY97 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Mentor backs Q2, FY97 estimates.

text.p: Mentor Corp said Wednesday it is comfortable with the First Call consensus of analysts' earnings estimates of $0.26 a share for the current second quarter and $1.11 for fiscal 1997.
Asked about the $1.11 estimate for the year, Mentor Chairman Christopher Conway said, "I think we'd be pretty comfortable with that. It's within range.
In fiscal 1996, it earned $0.92 a share.
Asked about the second quarter estimate, he added, "it's pretty close."
Mentor makes medical and surgical devices for ophthalmic surgery, urology and plastic surgery. The company made a presentation to a Dain Bosworth investor conference here.
